RFP response — RFP — Northfield Council — order management
4 answered (1 reused, 1 adapted, 2 new), 1 gap

## Answers
1. Describe your hosting arrangements. — Acme Orders runs on servers in the EU (Frankfurt) with a second region in Dublin; data does not leave the EU. Daily backups are kept for 35 days. [RFP answers — 2026-06, Q4, reused]
2. Is your service ISO 27001 certified? — Partly: our hosting provider holds ISO 27001; Acme Orders itself is not certified. [Security, "Certifications", new]
3. Can orders be exported in bulk? — Yes: any order list can be exported as CSV from Orders → Export, with the current filter applied. [Help, "Exporting orders", adapted from RFP answers — 2026-06, Q11]
4. Describe your data retention. — Order data is kept while the account is open and for 90 days after closure, then deleted; backups age out after 35 days. [Security, "Retention", new]

## Gaps
- 5. Provide your pricing for 40 users over three years. — a price: the person; last quoted to a council in 2026-04 at $38 per user per month (RFP answers, Q9), for context only.

## Reused
- RFP answers — 2026-06: Q4 (reused), Q11 (adapted).

## Open questions
- Q4: the bank (2026-06) said 60 days after closure; the Security document (2026-10) says 90. The newer document was used; update the bank.
